[检测缺口] 无增量变更 diff: watcher 事件 → adapter 间无关联; 缺乏'文件 X 变更, 仅重扫 skill/hook 不重扫 mcp' 的能力
[兼容性缺口] Worker 中途切项目: isCurrent() 守护防止旧扫 clobber, 但若后台多个 worker 并行扫多项目, 状态一致性需重新设计 (当前单 worker 可行, 后台长生命周期需版本化快照)
[集成缺口] 生命周期整合: 当前 watcher/scanner/runtime 独立初始化, 缺乏统一的启动/关闭/重置入口; 后台索引器需中心事件总线或 task scheduler
risks: [性能风险] 全索引所有项目能力: 若数十个项目 × 全 .claude/.codex 扫描, 导致启动时间爆炸; 需 lazy-loading + 后台渐进 + 用户控制的 depth 策略 (GH-113 确认性能取舍: 暂保留浅索引为基础)
[一致性风险] 持久化缓存与 watcher 同步: 若磁盘 fingerprint 与实时 mtime 不一致 (时区/浮点精度/跨进程竞争), 导致增量判断失效; 需 content-hash + atomic 写入保证
[资源风险] 持久化存储选型: SQLite 写锁可能阻塞 watcher 事件处理; RocksDB/LMDB 存储格式稳定性; 需评估工程成本与可维护性 (当前 better-sqlite3 已在依赖中)
[中断风险] 扫描暂停/恢复: AbortController 无法阻止 adapter.scanAll() 内部 I/O; 需 adapter interface 扩展支持中断点; 或采用 generator-based 扫描器
[并发风险] 后台多 worker + 活动项目切换: isCurrent() 守护仅保护单 worker, 若后台有数个长生命周期 worker 并行扫, 中途切项目时需版本化快照隔离; 当前架构假设单 worker
[迁移风险] 类型契约变更: Asset/AssetSnapshot 扩展新字段 (e.g., scanDepth/scanPhase/cacheVersion) 需向后兼容; 持久化格式 schema 迁移复杂
[关键业务风险] 全局 ≠ 完整扫结果: 当前浅索引缺口被用户定性为 BUG (GH-113 澄清), 若继续延迟全索引, 用户认知与实现脱离; 需明确优先级与交付里程碑
[可观测性风险] 缺乏扫描进度/指标: 当前 progress 事件粗粒度 (per-adapter), 缺乏 ETA/速率/内存占用; 后台长期运行需详细指标与告警
[安全风险] sessionCache 与用户凭证: AssetFileCache 缓存 session 元数据包含 model/cost 等敏感字段; 持久化到磁盘需加密或隔离 (当前内存仅进程隔离)
[兼容性风险] Codex 与 Claude Code 扫描不对称: Codex 仅 T1 浅去重, 后续深扫逻辑未明确; 后台索引器需支持多 adapter 的异步 depth/priority 策略

maps.area: berth IPC 与渲染层 loading — 全量后台渐进增量可暂停索引器重构的当前实现映射
maps.currentBehavior:
IPC 层 (src/shared/types/ipc.ts): assets:snapshot/status/refresh 单向轮询调用; assets:progress 事件流传递 {status: AssetRuntimeStatus, partial?: AssetScanPartial}，其中 status 包含扫描状态 (idle|scanning|ready|stale|error) 与进度信息 (phase: discovering|parsing|indexing|deriving, current/total)。

主进程资产运行时 (src/main/engine/assets/runtime.ts AgentAssetRuntime): 全局单例管理单个 projectDir 的快照。scopeSelection (global|user|project 模式) 与扫描独立。refresh(reason, wait?) 触发扫描，流转 onProgress (逐适配器进度) 和 onPartial (累计资产无 raw 字段) 回调，最后发送 terminal status。snapshotCache 按 projectKey 缓存快照，scope 切换若有缓存直接服务 (无重扫)。

扫描适配器 (src/main/engine/scanner.ts AssetScanner): 按顺序串行扫描 claude-code/codex/agent-plugins，每个适配器前后发送 progress 事件，完成后发送累计 partial (资产、stats、errorCount)。

渲染层订阅 (src/renderer/src/hooks/use-ipc.ts useAssetRuntime): 挂载时查询 status，idle/stale/error 触发 refresh()。双订阅 onChanged (单项变化) 和 onProgress (扫描流)。applyAssetProgress 仅折叠 partial assets/stats，刻意不更新 assetSnapshotId (保留给完成时更新，避免 ID 键消费者重取)。

应用存储 (src/renderer/src/stores/app.ts useAppStore): assets/stats 渲染列表，assetRuntimeStatus 中央状态，scopeSelection/projectCandidates 域选择。applyAssetProgress 不触发页面重新请求。

域过滤 (src/shared/scope.ts): assetMatchesAppScope() 纯谓词 (global 返 true; user 过滤 enterprise/user scope; project 含继承链)。filterAssetsByAppScope() 渲染层单向操作，全量结果存 app.assets。

maps.area: Berth Settings & Persistence Layer - Current Architecture Mapping for Progressive Incremental Indexer Refactoring
maps.currentBehavior:
## Current Behavior

### Settings Storage
- **Browser localStorage only**: Theme (`berth-theme`), accent (`berth-accent`), language (`berth-language`), advanced mode, ignored health checks
- Located in renderer via `ThemeProvider` and pages (`overview.tsx`, `settings.tsx`, `pages/settings.tsx`)
- No server-side settings persistence (no electron-store, no JSON files, no SQLite)
- User can change theme/accent/language but NO persistent application-level settings

### Asset Indexing & Caching
- **In-process memory only**: `AssetFileCache<Asset>` (src/main/engine/assets/file-cache.ts) uses `Map<string, AssetFileCacheEntry>` with file fingerprints (path + size + mtimeMs)
- Session metadata caching: Caches parsed Claude Code sessions/Codex rollouts to avoid re-parsing unchanged files
- **No disk persistence**: Snapshots exist only in memory during runtime; lost on app restart
- Cache is rebuilding from scratch on every launch

### Scanning Architecture
- **On-demand full scans**: App starts → runs full scan immediately (no incremental skip)
- **Watcher-driven updates**: chokidar watches 25+ asset paths (~/.claude/, .codex/, .agents/, project dirs)
- **Worker thread isolation**: AssetWorkerHost spawns worker_threads for heavy I/O; sessionCache passed to worker as snapshot
- **Streaming partial results**: `onPartial` callbacks emit cumulative assets mid-scan (GH-111 P1, GH-113 T1)
- **Snapshot cache per project**: `snapshotCache: Map<projectKey, AssetSnapshot>` in runtime (in-memory) allows sub-second project switching

### Current Data Flow
1. App launch → `initScanner(projectDir)` → full scan in worker
2. Watcher listens for fs changes → `notifyChange()` → partial refresh triggers full re-scan
3. Renderer requests snapshot via IPC → gets latest in-memory snapshot
4. Changing project scope → swaps runtime.projectDir → instant cache lookup or triggers new scan

### Better-SQLite3 Status
- **Included in package.json** (v11.7.0) but **NOT USED** anywhere in codebase
- No database initialization, schema, or queries exist
- Listed in `.onlyBuiltDependencies` (native module), meaning it compiles but sits unused
- Declared in README as "Storage" tech but no actual implementation

No cache invalidation strategy beyond fingerprint - no TTL, no LRU, no versioning; can't detect deep changes (moved files, symlinks)

Worker thread memory leak potential - sessionCache snapshots passed per-scan; large transcripts × many scans = unbounded memory if not GC'd
Testing gaps - No fixtures for persisted cache behavior; E2E tests assume clean state each time
